# Data Source: yet_cloud_dns_zone

A DNS zone, by its domain.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "yet_cloud_dns_zone" "acme" {
  name = "acme.dev"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The domain: `acme.dev`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Its id.
- `nameservers` (List of String) Where the domain's registrar has to point.
- `status` (String) `pending` or `active`.
